details: Bitcoin has seen a rebound above the $60,000 mark as investors look forward to upcoming U.S. payrolls data, which could influence Federal Reserve policy. This comes after Bitcoin had previously slipped below $59,000 due to a strong dollar and Fed uncertainty, and logged a 14% quarterly loss. The latest recovery indicates resilience despite significant ETF outflows in recent months.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds Above $60K Amid US Jobs Data Anticipation

details: Smaller cryptocurrencies have outperformed in a broad market recovery, with the CoinDesk 20 Index increasing by almost 5% in the past 24 hours. Notable gains include Memecore's M (81%), Audiera's BEAT (12%), and Venice Token (9%). Major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Solana also advanced, gaining over 4% and 9% respectively.
title: Smaller Tokens Lead Crypto Market Rebound, CoinDesk 20 Index Rises

details: Robinhood has launched its Layer 2 mainnet, marking a significant step in its global expansion and product vision. This initiative includes features for tokenized stock trading and aims to meet the growing prediction market boom. This development could enhance the utility and accessibility of digital assets within their platform.
title: Robinhood Expands Crypto Footprint with Layer 2 Mainnet for Tokenized Stock Trading

details: Paolo Ardoino, CEO of Tether, stated that the company has not applied for a license under the European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) framework. Ardoino expressed concerns that MiCA could pose risks to stablecoins, potentially forcing issuers to hold a significant portion of reserves as uninsured cash in smaller European banks. This decision by Tether follows reports of the company abandoning Europe due to the MiCA ban impacting USDT on exchanges.
title: Tether CEO Dismisses EU MiCA License Application, Citing Regulation Concerns

details: A new nonprofit called "Ethereum Institutional" has been launched with the goal of accelerating Wall Street's engagement with Ethereum. Backed by Ethereum co-founder Joe Lubin, along with treasury firms BitMine Immersion Technologies and SharpLink, this initiative will serve as a direct point of contact for financial institutions looking to explore tokenization, stablecoins, and other on-chain financial infrastructure.
title: Ethereum Institutional Launched to Boost On-Chain Adoption for Traditional Finance
